title: Tooth Fairy Clipart
author: Chokdeesign
description:
You will receive:
♥ 1 of each image as shown in picture- PNG files 11 in totals.
♥ PNG files have a transparent background and are perfect to use as graphics in most programs.
♥ Watermark will not be on digital images purchased.
♥ Images are drawn perfect for making your own papercraft, scrapbooking, incorporating with cards, and much more.
You can print at home as much as you want to.
